device.name: eSpire314_ESMU
device.notes: Treated as the eSpire 314 register map per the request that produced this template - the source PDF never uses the name 'eSpire' or '314', only 'ESMU'. Extracted from a bilingual table-heavy PDF (docs/eSpire314_ESMU_Modbus_Register_Map.md has full notes, per-point 'confidence' field mirrors that doc's tiers: high/medium/low). System alarms (SystemAlarm_*) are true Modbus discrete-input reads (function 02H) which keystone-controller-logic's reader/compiler does not yet support (see ModbusNumericType in src/types.ts) - each alarm point's 'notes' field flags this explicitly. Per-string alarms (base 100*(N+1), 88 regs) and per-string/per-cell telemetry (base 100+3000*(N-1), 2991 regs, up to 700 cells) are NOT enumerated as individual points here - see the register map doc section 4.2/6.4 for the address formulas.

Point # of the maximum battery voltage within its string

Point # of the minimum battery voltage within its string

System accumulated charge quantity for a single cycle, 0.1kWh/bit
System accumulated discharge quantity for a single cycle, 0.1kWh/bit
System rechargeable capacity (UINT32), 0.1kWh/bit. Corrected from address 32 (IRUS) - verified against vendor doc p.41: address 32 is actually Allowable Maximum Discharge Power.
System discharge capacity (UINT32), 0.1kWh/bit. Corrected from address 33 (IRUS) - verified against vendor doc p.41: address 33 is actually Allowable Maximum Charge Power.
Allowable maximum charge power, 0.1kW/bit. Corrected from address 34 - verified against vendor doc p.41.
Allowable maximum discharge power, 0.1kW/bit. Corrected from address 35 (previously mislabeled with a current/offset description belonging to a different register) - verified against vendor doc p.41.

Allowable maximum charge current, 0.1A/bit. Corrected from address 36 - verified against vendor doc p.41. NOTE: table text still shows offset -1600.0A for this register, but the V2.1 changelog claims this offset was removed in section 5.1.3 - source document is self-contradictory here, confirm with vendor before applying the offset.

Allowable maximum discharge current, 0.1A/bit. Corrected from address 37 - verified against vendor doc p.41. NOTE: table text still shows offset -1600.0A for this register, but the V2.1 changelog claims this offset was removed in section 5.1.3 - source document is self-contradictory here, confirm with vendor before applying the offset.
